XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
The car's equipment includes a service indicator, located at the bottom of the instrument panel.
The indicator shows the driver icons relating to the various service items provided by the on-board computer, based on the maintenance required by the condition of the vehicle and the way it has been used.

Once the actions indicated by the indicator have been carried out, reset the indicator by following the procedure below:

  • It is not necessary to press any pedals during the procedure.
  • Close the vehicle and wait for approximately 10 minutes.
  • Unlock the vehicle using the remote control.
  • Press the engine start button 3 times in quick succession.
  • Press button (1) (and hold it down for at least 10 seconds) to display the icon for the first service item.
  • Press the button (1) in short bursts to scroll through the icons for the other service items
  • The display will show the item "Reset executable?"
  • Press and hold the button (1) for at least 3 seconds
  • The display will show the message "Perform reset?"
  • Press and hold the button (1) for at least 3 seconds to reset the displayed item, repeating the operation for each of the service items concerned.
  • Switch off the ignition

The texts shown on the display may differ depending on the vehicle version.

Each service item can only be reset if a condition equal to 90 per cent of the expected service life for the part concerned is detected.

The "brake service" item can only be reset if the relevant wear sensor is functioning correctly.

Before proceeding with the reset, check that the on-board clock is set to the correct time.
